I found four households: **HH-0586, HH-0592, HH-0928 and HH-4821**. In each, a signed householding agreement puts three accounts into one billing group, but the portfolio system still bills them in two groups.

The four cases follow the same pattern. The householding letter covers the joint account, a spouse's traditional IRA and an adult child's individual account. It says they "are billed together as one group from the next billing cycle." In `portfolio/household.json`, though, the joint account and the IRA are in one billing group and the child's account is in a second. Both groups were last changed on the date of the child's advisory agreement, which is before the householding letter was signed. So the billing groups were never updated after the letter.

| Household | Agreement (signed) | Billing groups | Groups last changed |
